property_summary: After a lockInGuess call, a subsequent lockInGuess call from the same sender must always revert because guesses[msg.sender].block is non-zero; the bug leaves it zero, allowing a second lockInGuess to succeed without an intervening settle.
change_summary: Delete guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 1 so block remains 0 and lockInGuess can be called again without settle.
